Callout.Name: Alarm Activation
Callout.Message: Commercial alarm activated, keyholder on the way.
Callout.Advisory: No persons seen, building secure from the front.

Script.Line: It was me. I have the code. Look, I have the code.
That alarm does this. It does it when the wind is up.
I have been here twenty minutes. The keyholder is on his way.

Lines.Approach: Probably nothing - but the last three at this address were not.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
